name: better-neighbors
description: PD Intelligence skills for Claude, from BetterNeighborsAI / Public Democracy

plugins.name: pd-intelligence
plugins.description: Skills for turning PD Intelligence social data into reports people read: navigation and metric semantics, briefings, post/comment deep-dives, creator analysis, bulk pulls with local caching, news briefings, report rendering as a written document, an interactive data story, or a slide deck, tag and roster curation, and publishing/sharing through PD Docs

plugins.name: pd-intel-code
plugins.description: Claude Code mod for exploring PD Intelligence data and building reports from it, made for non-technical users: /pd opens a panel with your datasets and the chosen one's numbers at a glance (press a dataset to work in it, one-press Explore and Write a report), the chosen dataset shows in the status line and Claude uses it without asking, an evidence ledger lists every PD Intelligence call for a report's sources (optionally saving raw results as JSON for charts), and destructive writes always ask
